thread:
amanda_cs: FYI Greenlock just sent over a vendor security questionnaire. They specifically want a data-flow map and a table of third-party data access. they marked it high-priority, renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks :grimacing:

derek_security: ok can you drop the PDF? i want to confirm scope — are they asking for production traffic flow only or also logs/backups/analytics?

amanda_cs: uploaded the PDF here: https://files.redwood.internal/greenlock_vrq.pdf — quote from pg 4: 'Provide a data flow diagram showing where customer PII and embeddings are transmitted, stored, or processed, including third-party processors.'

sam_engineer: quick note: our hosted API doesn't store request bodies long-term. embeddings at rest are in encrypted object storage and backup retention is 90 days. logs_retention_days=30 for request traces (we can redact PII)

derek_security: good, we'll need to produce an explicit map: ingress -> routing -> model inference -> kv cache -> object store -> optional analytics. also table of who/what has access and for what purpose. i can draft the diagram if someone lists endpoints and the third parties (e.g., cloud-provider, telemetry vendor).

priya_ae: customer wants the diagram in 48h to unblock their legal review. renewal is next quarter but decision team wants security signoff ASAP. i can nudge them on scope but assume full flow is needed.

amanda_cs: noted — greenlock asked about SOC2 scope too, they want confirmation that production inference and backups are in scope. i replied that SOC2 covers hosted API and backups for our hosted customers, but asked security to confirm wording.

derek_security: confirm: SOC2 in-scope for hosted production and backups. private deployments are separate. i'll send a short statement.

sam_engineer: for the diagram i'll need the following from CS: sample endpoints (api.redwood.ai/v1/generate, /v1/embeddings), which models they're using (gpt-3o-shadow etc), and whether they use streaming. also any customer-provided connectors we configured.

amanda_cs: copying what i have from onboarding: using hosted generate + embeddings, streaming enabled. no custom connectors. models pinned to 'redwood/base-2' for now.

derek_security: ok pushing an initial pack: (1) data-flow PNG, (2) table CSV of processors+access, (3) short SOC2 statement. i'll attach by EOD tomorrow. priya — can you confirm Greenlock's legal contact for upload?

priya_ae: legal contact is claire.hsu@greenlock.com. i'll share the vendor's secure upload link.

sec-bot: SECURITY-CHECKLIST: items to include -> network diagram, data classification, retention policy, KMS details, least-privilege access list. see https://wiki.redwood/security/vendor-onboarding for template. :white_check_mark:

derek_security: thanks sec-bot. two questions for sam: what's the encryption-at-rest algorithm and KMS provider? we need exact phrasing (e.g., AES-256, Google Cloud KMS).

sam_engineer: AES-256 for object storage, KMS = AWS KMS for hosted region us-west-2. backups also encrypted server-side with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01 (i'll redact the real one in the doc).

amanda_cs: perfect. i'll assemble a one-page cover note with the renewal timeline and ask legal to accept the secure upload. anyone object if i include the sample flow diagram before derek finalizes? want to move fast.

derek_security: go ahead with 'draft - for review' label. i'll iterate.

priya_ae: i'll message claire to expect the upload and ask for any additional forms. thanks team. :pray:
